title: G DATA CSIRT publishes case study of Extortion-as-a-Service attack on a mid-sized company
date_note: G DATA blog post published 26 November 2026; the incident itself was handled in December 2025.
summary: G DATA says its CSIRT handled an Extortion-as-a-Service attack on a mid-sized company in December 2025. According to G DATA, the police, not internal monitoring, alerted the company to suspicious network traffic. G DATA says archives were uploaded to Azure cloud storage with AzCopy: 231 archives were created, 27 stayed in the network, and the total was around 2.5 terabytes.
plain: Security firm G DATA describes how attackers stole around 2.5 terabytes of data from a mid-sized company in an extortion attack, found only after police warned the company.
exec: G DATA says a mid-sized firm learned of an extortion attack from the police, not its own monitoring; around 2.5 terabytes were taken.

key_findings: G DATA CSIRT handled an Extortion-as-a-Service attack on a mid-sized company in December 2025.
231 archives were created; 27 stayed in the network.
Around 2.5 terabytes of data were exfiltrated.

evidence.quote: Insgesamt entstanden 231 Archive, von denen der Großteil erfolgreich exfiltriert wurde.
Lediglich 27 Archive blieben durch die rechtzeitige Internettrennung im Netzwerk.
Die Gesamtmenge von rund 2,5 Terabyte verdeutlicht die Dimension des Angriffs.

validation.note: Vendor case study by the responding firm; one source, victim unnamed.
